authority: Static House Tang departure-issue policy. Mutable food, fodder and ammunition remain owned by the House garrison depot; mutable equipment remains owned by the House armory inventory until exact formation issue.

field_service_preparation.rule: When Tang Wei has explicitly ordered campaign preparation for all of his House-controlled field formations and those formations are physically at the Tang Manor garrison depot, House quartermasters form a campaign wagon train carrying a one-hundred-twenty-day food and mount-fodder reserve, raise formation arrow custody to thirty standard 36-arrow loads per fighter whose registered loadout uses that quiver, and stage spare registered loadout equipment equal to fifty percent of formation personnel from exact on-hand armory reserve. This is campaign-train logistics rather than a personal carried load. Missing stock becomes an explicit shortfall for normal production or later lawful procurement; it is never created on demand. Replacement mounts require a separate explicit order.
